title: A DSCR covenant stated with the common Indian-banking abbreviation extracts cleanly

input.clause_text: The Company undertakes that the Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) shall not fall below 1.25x for each financial year.

note: The ratio-name alias table (domain.intake.candidates._RATIO_NAME_ALIASES) matches both 'dscr' and 'debt service coverage ratio' to the dscr definition. 'shall not fall below' is a min-direction comparison phrase, and 1.25 is well inside dscr's plausible band of [-5, 20].
